name: Partscript CAD
install:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"

NODE_VERSION=24.22.3
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(node -v)" != "v${NODE_VERSION}" ]; then
  curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v${NODE_VERSION}/node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-x64.tar.xz" -o "/tmp/node-v${NODE_VERSION}.tar.xz"
  sudo tar -xJ -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner -f "/tmp/node-v${NODE_VERSION}.tar.xz"
  rm -f "/tmp/node-v${NODE_VERSION}.tar.xz"
fi
hash -r

# The image puts Node 22 ahead of /usr/local/bin. Keep Node 24 first for login shells.
MARKER="# partscript: node 24 on PATH"
if [ -f "$HOME/.bashrc" ] && ! grep -qF "$MARKER" "$HOME/.bashrc"; then
  printf '\n%s\nexport PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"\n' "$MARKER" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"
fi
if [ ! -f /etc/profile.d/node24.sh ]; then
  printf '%s\nexport PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"\n' "$MARKER" | sudo tee /etc/profile.d/node24.sh >/dev/null
fi

python3 -m pip install --user --disable-pip-version-check playwright

[ ! -d '/agent/repos/partscript-cad' ] || cd '/agent/repos/partscript-cad' || exit $?
npm ci
start:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
[ ! -d '/agent/repos/partscript-cad' ] || cd '/agent/repos/partscript-cad' || exit $?
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:5173/; then
  exit 0
fi
exec npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173
